capabilities: Look up double-clicked Pāli words in dictionaries
Search Pāli dictionaries and suttas from a sidebar
Open Word Lookup result windows with Pāli accents
extras: Requires keeping the Simsapa app running in the background; the README notes the Word Lookup pop-up may be blocked by the system and describes a workaround.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up Pāli words or search sutta texts while reading notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin requires Simsapa Dhamma Reader to be installed to work.

summary: Sidebar and double-click lookup that queries Pāli dictionaries and suttas through the Simsapa Dhamma Reader desktop app over HTTP.
